title: Open-source ACIS kernel candidates and modern AcDs reader boundaries
mode: Deeper/broader primary-source research and plan-readiness refinement

localScope.head: de27a33
localScope.worktreeState: The worktree was already broadly modified and uncommitted. This research pass edited the parity plan and its 3D-plan summary and created two research receipts; no prior or unrelated work was staged or committed.

sources.project: ACadSharp Prototype_1b reader discussion and merged reader
sources.observation: The issue/PR discussion surfaces multi-schema files, distinctions between blobs and data entries, payloads split across non-sequential blob01 records, and the evolution from signature scanning to a full specification-oriented reader. The PR and maintainer report corpus comparisons, but these statements are not an independently reproduced run against an exact release artifact.
sources.planDisposition: Refine the optional PAR-07/S8 and PAR-144 structural comparison to include multiple schemas, split/reordered blobs, blob-versus-indexed-entry accounting, and entity-handle attachment, with separate denominators and exact artifact/source pinning. ODA v5.4.1 and local producer traces remain authoritative.

sources.observation: The project describes an ACIS feature that lifts SatDocument into a project-owned B-rep and lowers it back, which could eventually supply a geometry-kernel lineage distinct from OCCT. Its README labels the project early and says most operations are not yet written; the ACIS feature depends on opencadcodec, so its outer DWG/DXF codec route is not independent of the ACadRust-derived family.
sources.planDisposition: Record as a future candidate only. Do not treat it as an available resolver, semantic pass, or reason to wait. Admission requires an exact commit/build, a demonstrated supported ACIS profile, complete body/face disposition, valid topology, and pre-authored analytic expectations.

sources.observation: The published rendering pipeline describes lifting ACIS data into a kernel B-rep and a direct per-surface fallback when a face cannot be expressed; incomplete tessellation is explicitly marked. OpenCADStudio v2026.42 release notes add a SAT/ACIS import workflow. This is a useful display-projection lead, not evidence of arbitrary B-rep validity or an independent DWG parser, because its file codec follows the ACadRust lineage and a rendered mesh is downstream output.
sources.planDisposition: At most an optional composed-checkpoint projection diagnostic. Pin application, codec, and kernel revisions; record per-handle and per-face complete-lift/fallback/omitted/failed states. Never count a rendered mesh as semantic support or another parser vote.

sources.observation: LibreDWG has a modern AcDs section reader but its project documentation describes remaining incompleteness. ezdxf exposes and inspects DXF SAT/SAB data, while its documentation says generation of valid ACIS content requires an external library. These capabilities occupy different sections of the parse/carrier/author/semantic pipeline.
sources.planDisposition: Retain them as exact-version structural and DXF-carrier comparators only. No support claim follows from section presence, raw carrier access, or broad version declarations.

existingOwnersRefined: PAR-07/S8: staged modern-AcDs structural, association, semantic, and consumer evidence
PAR-59: modeler carrier versus semantic-loss attribution
PAR-144: optional peer checkpoint and generated boundary cases

sequence: Continue local slices without waiting for peers; use the owning fast selector after code changes.
At the existing optional AcDs checkpoint, add scratch-generated one/multi-schema, split/non-sequential blob, blob-versus-indexed-entry, alignment/count-boundary, and missing/duplicate-key controls.
Keep section framing, record bytes, payload reconstruction, handle/key association, B-rep semantics, and native acceptance as separate outcomes with separate denominators.
Revisit OpenCADKernel only when a pinned artifact demonstrably implements an exercised ACIS lift path and complete analytic-solid controls; otherwise record NOT_READY and continue.
Keep third-party DWG/DXF files out of committed fixtures; generated controls must be created locally from scratch or remain scratch-only.
After each implementation item, update the plan and receipt, show progress after the slice commit, and self-unblock to the next dependency-ready local item.
implementationReadiness.supportBoundary: No peer project description, same-codec roundtrip, raw payload match, or incomplete tessellation can promote DWG/DXF or ACIS semantic support.

limitations: No external drawing was downloaded. No peer executable, OpenCADStudio build, geometry kernel, or native CAD application was run. Peer discussion and project documentation are discovery/readiness evidence only. No finding or deferred J item was resolved; J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 remain DEFERRED_EXTERNAL and non-promoting.
